cleansingStrength.rationale: Moderate: Sodium Laureth Sulfate #2 buffered by Cocamidopropyl Betaine #4 (Sodium Xylenesulfonate #3 is a hydrotrope, TEA-Dodecylbenzenesulfonate #18 is a trace emulsifier, not a reinforcing route); no reset intent (C1).

conditioningLevel.rationale: Moderate: one meaningful conditioning system - silicone/cationic deposition from Dimethiconol #10, Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride #11 and Dimethicone #14; Panthenol #19 late. No pearlizer, fatty alcohol or lipid, so not the C2 multi-system pattern.
conditioningLevel.counterSignal: two silicones plus cationic could be read as complementary systems (high)

weightPotential.rationale: Moderate: depositionLoad moderate (silicone gum Dimethiconol #10 + Dimethicone #14 + guar #11), persistence moderate (silicones), resetCapacity moderate (SLES/betaine). W1-type silicone+guar in an effective sulfate/betaine base without rich 2-in-1 architecture.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: low would need deposition absent/light; silicone gum is persistent

focusPrimary.rationale: General: the dominant positioning is anti-hair-loss / growth / density ('Anti-Haarverlust', 'dichteres Haar', 'Haarwurzeln'), which is medically adjacent and out of scope (E2). The residual 'verringert Haarbruch' claim sits on a nonspecific silicone/guar formula (7.3), so no specialist focus has a coherent case. Piroctone Olamine #6 is present without dandruff positioning, so it does not create scalp_active.

focusPrimary.decisionTrace: Hair-loss claims excluded; repair claim over nonspecific conditioning -> general.
